create_get_standard_colors: create a function that generates standard matplotlib colors from a colormap, color type, or explicit color list
get_colors_from_colormap: get a list of colors sampled evenly from a matplotlib colormap by name or instance
generate_random_colors: generate a list of random RGB colors given a count using numpy random generator
cycle_colors: cycle through a list of colors to produce at least the requested number of color values
validate_color_string: validate whether a string is a recognized matplotlib color name or alias
